name: Indonesian
modelReview: built 2026-11-19. Usage notes written in Indonesian by a writer told nothing of cron (the writer could open no calendar or reminder app text; some press quotations are search excerpts). Answers, lexicon and hand-written rows by Claude Fable 5.2 the same day, in three author passes against one adversarial schedule read of all 637 rows and two blind readers briefed only in Indonesian, each asked for every reading of each sentence. Renderer built by an agent that saw no other renderer and no held-out row: 153 of 153 held-out rows on the first judged run; two visible rows open, both settled for the rows, with the rule restated. Audited by an independent agent (about 600 patterns read against the answer key, 54,000 random renderings): no sentence stated wrong fire times; five misleading or unholdable forms repaired test-first, 27 hard-case rows added, one held-out row changed with its reason. Not read by anyone independent: the 177 forms of the last author pass and the 53 the audit changed. Thin evidence: «jam genap» / «jam ganjil» (no corpus support for hours); «pukul 00.00 dini hari» for midnight under hour12; «keduanya», «semuanya». Known heavy forms: ten stretches for hours in runs plus a rhythm under a quarter-hour; «menit pertama» beside «menit ke-1». Taste calls by the orchestrating model (Claude Fable 5.2) are recorded in the answers with their evidence.
